# gitsize

> Explains why a git repository's .git is big: the largest blobs in all history, whether each is still in HEAD, the commit that introduced it, growth per month, suggested fix commands, and an SVG diagram of where history weight lives.

gitsize is a read-only Go CLI that uses the git CLI (2.31 or newer). It never rewrites history, runs gc or fetches. `gitsize --json` prints a stable JSON report with documented exit codes, and `gitsize --mcp` serves the same report to MCP clients as the read-only tool `gitsize_report`, plus `gitsize_svg`, which writes the `--svg` diagram. The git filter-repo and BFG commands it prints are suggestions for a human to review.

## Docs

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/Mr-hunt-007/gitsize/blob/main/skills/gitsize/SKILL.md): Agent Skill for using gitsize from a coding agent
